name: Sail Masjid
summary: A single sail-shaped shell lifts above a broad open prayer hall, balanced by a clear slender minaret.
why: The sweeping roof creates a contemporary mosque silhouette without repeating an onion dome. A generous entrance opens beneath the shell, while the slender minaret anchors the building in Islamic architecture. Wide negative spaces preserve a light, airy feeling.
risk: The roof is deliberately modern and can suggest a pavilion. The distinct minaret and open prayer hall carry the mosque identity.
reasonToChoose: You want a mosque expressed through a bold contemporary roof.

palette.name: SAIL MASJID / HARBOR BLUE + IVORY + SEA GLASS
